name: excalidrawer
description: Create, edit, validate, and export polished Excalidraw diagrams from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Create and edit polished Excalidraw diagrams from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Excalidrawer gives Codex a reusable workflow and MCP tools for generating .excalidraw scene files from a diagram IR, editing them, validating JSON and visual layout quality, and exporting reviewable SVG or PNG artifacts.
defaultPrompt: Create an Excalidraw system diagram for this repo.
Edit this .excalidraw file and add the missing flow.
Export this Excalidraw scene as SVG.
